newsitem.title: USA: Callaway gets order against Professsional.
newsitem.headline: Callaway gets order against Professsional.

text.p: Callaway Golf Co said a California federal court issued a preliminary injunction October 28 against Florida-based Professional Edge Golf Inc.
The order prevents the manufacture, distribution, and sale of allegedly illegal copies of Callaway's best-selling Great Big Bertha Metal Woods, Big Bertha War Bird Metal Woods, and Tuttle Putters.

Callaway said the court order rejected arguments raised by Professional Edge to defend its copies, and is the result of a lawsuit filed against Professional Edge by Callaway Golf on August 22, 1996. Professional Edge had no immediate comment.
A Professional spokesman later said that the company disagreed with the court's decision and expects to appeal.
